items.title: Polymarket traders see a 10% chance the AI bubble bursts before New Year’s Day
items.description: For investors worried that the runaway artificial-intelligence trade might be about to hit the skids, prediction markets are already starting to reflect that anxiety.

items.title: Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every kid in America — don’t hold your breath
items.description: Trick or treat? Musk has a long record of saying things have little relation to reality.

items.title: AI stocks are probably in a bubble — but might be worth holding on to, says Citadel’s Ken Griffin

items.title: My partner of 17 years left me his $1 million home. His children say I influenced him to do so. Should I share my inheritance?
items.description: “I never paid rent, although I put about $45,000 toward a new kitchen and a roof.”

items.title: Moderna is about to release the trial results for its cancer vaccine. A lot is riding on this data.

items.title: Money-saving habits to cope with higher prices — from our readers

items.title: I receive 10 calls a day promising me $15,000 loans at 8% interest. Are these legitimate offers?

items.title: Time for a Micron mindset shift? Here’s how to navigate the new AI landscape.

items.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
items.description: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”
